blurb.en: Open datasets and evidence links (`published_dataset`, `uses_dataset`). MINAM/datosabiertos nodes pending research/ecosystem-policy curation.

blurb.en: Challenge-centered constellations: solid = verified data; dashed = suggested partnership paths to explore.
